meta.title: RI'AYA — Intelligent clinic operations
meta.description: RI'AYA helps clinics run calmer days: scheduling, patient flow, and operational clarity in English, Arabic, and French.

hero.title: Better care starts with a better flow.
hero.subtitle: RI'AYA gives clinical teams a calm, multilingual workspace for appointments, staffing, and daily operations — so patients wait less and teams see more clearly.

features.title: Everything the front desk and clinicians share
features.s1Body: Keep calendars balanced across doctors, rooms, and visit types without the usual back-and-forth.
features.s2Body: Waiting lists, check-in, and live status stay visible so queues stay honest and quiet.
features.s3Body: Spot bottlenecks early with utilization, wait time, and cancellation signals you can act on.
features.s4Body: One workspace for staff, capacity, and the day ahead — with access limited to the right roles.

dark.title: Less operational noise. More time for patients.
dark.body: RI'AYA surfaces the few numbers that matter on a clinic day. Figures below are sample data for illustration.

footer.blurb: Clinic operations, designed to stay out of the way.
